environment.browser_mode: Playwright CLI isolated real Chrome, headless

method: Navigate to public production homepage, open the actual file chooser and select valid long PDF files.
Leave production scripts, ad requests and Sentry reporting active; do not intercept requests, replace APIs, inject exceptions, throttle CPU, force GC or impose memory limits.
Read DOM page-image counts and natural image sizes; observe rendering progress, error UI, page exceptions, diagnostic console events and the test page own Sentry envelopes.
Sample only the known isolated test browser PID and descendants using host ps RSS; read main-target Runtime.getHeapUsage without requesting garbage collection.
Run cases sequentially in fresh isolated browsers; close each previous browser before starting the next conversion.

findings: All four valid long PDF documents completed initial rendering and all expected page images loaded. No matching fetch_image_data/read_image_blob TypeError, Worker diagnostic failure or test-page Sentry exception was observed.
Reader memory grew substantially with document progress. Large measured values support a memory-pressure risk, but do not prove out-of-memory caused the historical events.

The reader keeps per-page original and display data URLs; the measured main-target backing-storage growth is consistent with retained page data, but measurements do not attribute every byte to a particular application allocation.

separate_ui_observation.observation: An ordinary top anchor advertisement intercepted the reader-settings button after rendering completed. Clicking its visible collapse handle recovered normal controls. No PDF read exception occurred.

limitations: The original failing user PDF and actual Android/Windows devices were unavailable. Desktop Chrome with tablet viewport does not reproduce a low-memory Android environment.

The scan fixture contains independent image objects and distinct pixel data, but its background derives from the same public example with per-page rasterized numbers; it does not represent the full content diversity of a real scanned textbook.
RSS sampled maxima can miss instantaneous peaks. A largest renderer is not proven to be the PDF unique physical memory; renderer sums can double-count shared memory and include ads.
Main-target JS heap omits some Worker, image, canvas, Blob and GPU memory. Do not add backing storage to RSS as disjoint allocations.
The first text case previously visited the homepage in its root tab, leaving additional renderer overhead in that browser baseline. Treat its renderer-sum delta cautiously.

The first text case screenshot was taken during smooth scrolling. Initial rendering is verified, but its jump to the last page was not verified; later cases wait until the last page enters the viewport.
No error reproduction and no observed OOM do not exclude browser/resource pressure on the original user device. No fix or deployment was made in this task.

sentry_issue_recheck.basis: Reloaded authenticated Sentry issue UI after all four cases. Events remained 2; the latest selected event was the original Windows event.

independent_review.scope: Read-only comparison of report with original case summaries and scan fixture verification
independent_review.conclusion_boundary: This Mac production test did not reproduce the original error. Observed memory growth cannot confirm or rule out OOM on original Android/Windows devices.
